notes.title: V 1.3 More Controller Support! (Including Joy Cons!)
notes.content: Added support of a lot more controllers, including nintendo switch joy cons!  Also threw in a lot of bug fixes for good measure!

notes.title: 1.2 Patch
notes.content:
+~ Added instructions splash screen ~+
+~ Fixed color wheel bug ~+
+~ Fixed monitor resolution bugs ~+

notes.title: 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
+~ Vsync is now toggle-able, though we still recommend leaving it on ~+
+~ Lowered minimum particle density ~+
+~ Direct hit bug fixed ~+

Many thanks to the fine folks at ArcadeCrowd for bringing some of these to our attention!
